page.overview:
Who is Fera Sormen?

Fera is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of the series.

She was born in, and went to the White Tower in the series. She spent 13 years as a novice and 9 as Accepted.

She was on the White Tower secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner by the Asha'man at Dumai's Wells and has sworn fealty to Rand al'Thor. However, unlike the other Aes Sedai, her oath was a lie.
